population: Use the registered 12 early/91 and 25 later/209 temporal-update windows in six training histories. Target history is excluded from every donor calculation. Pilot uses only conv-26_s5 (known when proposed); stage six uses the six session-5 windows and stage twelve both session-5 and session-7 windows from every training history. Wait for the whole designated stage, retain unmatchable donor statuses and never replace them. Score all registered later questions, separating pre-existing endpoints, before-UPDATE forecasts and forecasts preceding either physical endpoint. Independent benchmarks remain locked.
state: From pre-write, anonymized Qwen embeddings already registered for each turn and visible source text only. Old-partition covariates are mean best previous-turn cosine for current turns, mean of the top-three best matches for time/correction-cue turns (zero if absent), and cue-turn fraction. New-partition covariates are log(1+current word count), mean maximum other-current-turn cosine and share of current turns ending in a question mark. Scale by median and IQR of the eligible early source windows outside the target history, with a floor of 0.1 on each scale.
estimator: The terminal F1 change is decomposed into the symmetric average of the two measured orderings of swaps of pre-existing and new items. For each donor window take the mean over all its eligible questions. Smooth each component on its own source covariates with Gaussian weights exp(-0.5*mean(standardized_difference_squared)). Each donor history has total base mass one, with one pseudo-history at zero effect. Add the signed mean of only surviving rule-2 credit under a joint kernel, then use sigmoid(clip(25*advantage,-2,2)) for the conditional UPDATE probability. A helper outcome never gives additional selection credit. Freeze all numeric choices at each stage before reading later outcomes for scoring. No target question text, labels, actual writes or cross-bank outcomes enter prediction.
controls: Fixed skills, original native conditional policy, original continuity rule, 0.5, same mean use across matched windows, same split component predictions without extra credit, a single joint kernel with identical total returns and credit, and a joint terminal-only kernel. Cost and probabilities remain separate from deterministic endpoint F1. Recompute checksums of consumed pure-training artifacts. Report score and split-vs-pooled effect by history and question type. For eligibility to move to independent validation require at least 90% of eligible later questions, +0.02 expected F1 vs native and pooled terminal-only, improvement over pooled credit, split-without-credit and matched use, at least four histories beating matched use, and positive direction on strict prospective data. Full independent validation and frozen tests are still required.
